questions.subject: ANALYTICAL_CHEMISTRY
questions.learningObjective: compute chromatographic resolution
questions.stem: Two peaks elute at 3.65 and 5.46 min with equal baseline widths of 0.81 min. What is the chromatographic resolution?

options.misconception: inverts the resolution ratio
omits the factor of two in the resolution expression
uses the sum of both peak widths in the denominator, halving the resolution

questions.explanation: Resolution is two times the difference in retention times divided by the common peak width: Rs = 2(5.46 - 3.65)/0.81 = 4.469. Using the sum of both widths as the denominator halves the value, while omitting the factor of two or inverting the ratio misstates the separation.
questions.hint: Rs = 2 Δt / w for equal peak widths.
